How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Central University of Kerala Project Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Central University of Kerala to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central University of Kerala Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Project Fellow position at the Central University of Kerala is 18-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Chemistry. NET qualification and/or relevant experience are preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Fellow position announced by the Central University of Kerala.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Central University of Kerala Project Fellow recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Fellow position is a contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the Central University of Kerala?
faq.answer: The official website of the Central University of Kerala can be found in the Important Links section, allowing you to navigate to their portal for more information.
